using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
int p, k, answer, visited[1 << 20];

int compute() {
    answer = 1;
    if (k == 0) {
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            answer = (long long)answer * p % MOD;
        }
    } else if (k == 1) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) {
            answer = (long long)answer * p % MOD;
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                int length = 0;
                int current = i;
                while (!visited[current]) {
                    visited[current] = 1;
                    ++length;
                    current = (long long)current * k % p;
                }
                if (current != 0) {
                    answer = (long long)answer * p % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("data", "r", stdin);
#endif
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << compute();
}
